values.zh-CN: 实体 JSON 枚举与 I/O

content.markdown:
The migration adapter `createVscodeDataMigrationStorage.listJsonFiles` selects regular files whose names end in `.json` case-insensitively, rejects any case-insensitive JSON-suffixed entry whose reported type is not `File`, and sorts selected names with `localeCompare`. Non-JSON entries are ignored.

The ordinary `snlDoc.ts` `entityReadStorage` is different: it selects only direct regular files with exact lowercase `.json`, silently ignoring uppercase `.JSON` names and non-file JSON-suffixed entries. A current Dashboard refresh normally consumes the operation snapshot built by the migration adapter, while direct Entry/Macro/Package readers may use the ordinary adapter. Conformance tests MUST name the adapter and API under test rather than assuming one enumeration rule.

Every selected file MUST remain present, be readable, and parse through a non-fatal UTF-8 `TextDecoder` followed by native `JSON.parse`. Malformed byte sequences can become replacement characters; duplicate JSON keys use JavaScript last-key-wins semantics. A disappearance or parse/I/O failure is fatal for the snapshot or inspection.
